That is a same-statement, different-name twin of Causal.Causality.IsCauchySurface.cover_of_t1_secondCountable (Causal/SingularCauchy.lean:110), which a layer-1 module cannot import (model_path SingularCauchy -> SingularGeroch -> SingularFlat). (d) The hypothesis checklist is restated against the PAPER's hypotheses (kb/0006), with ⚠ strengthened rows for hK, hDac, ψ, the sing₀ facts and Lemma 3.3's time function. The paper quotes of lem:image_diamant, lem:passe_pgcd and lem:Sigma_separe are restored. (e) New: range_gateArc and the off-identity witness timelikeLine_gateArc_secondCountable. 2. GRADUATION. HOIST PROPOSAL (kb/0061). Causal.Causality.IsCauchySurface.cover_of_t1_secondCountable is model-free (read: T1 and second countable, any causality, exists_inextensible_of_t1_secondCountable only) but sits in the model-path Causal.SingularCauchy. A hoist would let layer-1 modules use them, and this file would then drop its inlined cover. 4. DEC-167 (gluing reading of defi:causalite, a future refactor).
